### `POST` `/api/v1/compliance/dvir`
Implemented in [`complianceService.createDvir`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/first-project/blob/main/src/services/compliance.ts#L156-L194).

#### 1. Purpose
Submits a digital pre-trip or post-trip DVIR inspection checklist and computes a canonical SHA-256 seal for tamper-evident certification.

#### 2. Parameters & Request Body
* **Request Body** (`application/json`):
  * `vehicleId` (`string`, required) – Commercial tractor ID (e.g. `TRK-900`).
  * `trailerId` (`string`, optional) – Trailer ID (e.g. `TRL-440`).
  * `driverId` (`string`, required) – Driver ID token.
  * `driverName` (`string`, required) – Full name of driver.
  * `odometer` (`number`, required) – Odometer at inspection.
  * `inspectionType` (`string`, required) – `PRE_TRIP` or `POST_TRIP`.
  * `items` (`array`, required) – List of safety items (`BRAKES`, `TIRES`, `STEERING`, `LIGHTING`, etc.) with `passed: boolean`.
  * `driverSignature` (`string`, required) – Digital signature string.

#### 3. Response Shape & Status Codes
* **Status**: `201 Created`
* **Schema**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "string",
  "data": {
    "id": "string",
    "vehicleId": "string",
    "driverName": "string",
    "odometer": 142880,
    "inspectionType": "PRE_TRIP",
    "items": [],
    "defectsCorrected": true,
    "sha256Seal": "string (64-char hex)"
  }
}
```

##### Request

## Pillar 2: Real-Time J1939 CAN-Bus & MTBF Predictive Maintenance

### `POST` `/api/v1/telematics/canbus/stream`
Implemented in [`telematicsService.ingestTelemetry`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/first-project/blob/main/src/services/telematics.ts#L112-L132).

#### 1. Purpose
Ingests high-frequency J1939 CAN-Bus broadcast packets, evaluates active SPN/FMI trouble codes, and relays frames to WebSocket subscribers.

  * `vehicleId` (`string`, required) – Tractor ID.
  * `engineRpm` (`number`, required) – Engine Speed (SPN 190).
  * `speedMph` (`number`, required) – Ground Speed (SPN 84).
  * `coolantTempC` (`number`, required) – Coolant Temp (SPN 110).
  * `oilPressurePsi` (`number`, required) – Oil Pressure (SPN 100).
  * `defLevelPercent` (`number`, optional) – DEF Tank Level (SPN 1761).
  * `fuelRateGph` (`number`, optional) – Fuel Rate (SPN 183).
  * `activeDtcs` (`array`, optional) – Active SPN/FMI trouble codes.

#### 3. Response Shape & Status Codes
* **Status**: `200 OK`
* **Schema**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "stored": true,
    "activeDtcsCount": 1,
    "predictiveAlerts": []
  }
}
```

##### Request


```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "stored": true,
    "activeDtcsCount": 1,
    "predictiveAlerts": [
      {
        "spn": 3251,
        "fmi": 2,
```

## Pillar 4: Salesforce CRM & Transport Cloud REST v60.0 Sync

### `POST` `/api/v1/salesforce/sync`
Implemented in [`salesforceService.syncPayload`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/first-project/blob/main/src/services/salesforce.ts#L61-L98).

#### 1. Purpose
Executes bidirectional synchronization of transport loads, accounts, and telemetry events with Salesforce Transport Cloud REST v60.0.

#### 2. Parameters & Request Body
* **Request Body** (`application/json`):
  * `organizationId` (`string`, required) – Salesforce Org ID.
  * `sourceSystem` (`string`, required) – Source identifier.
  * `records` (`object`, required) – Object containing `loads`, `accounts`, or `telemetryEvents` arrays.

#### 3. Response Shape & Status Codes
* **Status**: `200 OK`
* **Schema**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "recordsProcessed": 1,
  "syncTimestamp": "string (ISO 8601)",
  "appliedLoads": 1
}
```

#### 4. Example Request & Response
##### Request
```bash
curl -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/v1/salesforce/sync" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "organizationId": "00D8Z000002XYzeUAG",
    "sourceSystem": "TRUCKWITHEASE_FLEET_OS",
    "records": {
      "loads": [
        {
          "loadId": "LD-9920",
          "bolNumber": "BOL-2026-99999",
          "origin": "Houston Port Terminal, TX",
          "destination": "Memphis Rail Depot, TN",
          "stage": "DISPATCHED",
          "rateUsd": 3200
        }
      ]
    }
  }'
```
##### Response (`200 OK`)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "recordsProcessed": 1,
  "syncTimestamp": "2026-10-08T00:15:30.000Z",
  "appliedLoads": 1
}
```

#### 5. Errors & Edge Cases
| Status Code | Error Code | Description / Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `400 Bad Request` | `INVALID_SYNC_PAYLOAD` | Missing `records` object. |

```json
    "updatedRecord": {}
```

## Pillar 5: Voice Command Dispatch & Gemini Multimodal Co-Pilot

### `POST` `/api/v1/copilot/command`
Implemented in [`coPilotService.processVoiceCommand`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/first-project/blob/main/src/services/copilot.ts#L12-L103).

#### 1. Purpose
Parses hands-free driver speech transcripts using Gemini multimodal reasoning to execute cockpit actions (HOS breaks, radar queries, safe parking) and return synthesized audio responses.

#### 2. Parameters & Request Body
* **Request Body** (`application/json`):
  * `transcript` (`string`, required) – Speech-to-text transcript spoken by driver.
  * `driverId` (`string`, optional) – Commercial driver ID (defaults to `DRV-7701`).
  * `vehicleId` (`string`, optional) – Vehicle ID (defaults to `TRK-900`).
  * `ambientNoiseDb` (`number`, optional) – In-cab sound level in decibels.

#### 3. Response Shape & Status Codes
* **Status**: `200 OK`
* **Schema**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "commandId": "string",
    "recognizedIntent": "LOG_HOS_EVENT | TRIGGER_DVIR | ROUTE_HAZARD_INQUIRY | DISPATCH_ETA_UPDATE | PARKING_SAFE_HAVEN_REQUEST | UNKNOWN",
    "confidenceScore": 0.98,
    "extractedParameters": {},
    "coPilotVoiceReply": "string",
    "dispatchedActionTaken": true
  }
}
```

#### 4. Example Request & Response
##### Request
```bash
curl -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/v1/copilot/command" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "transcript": "Take a 30 minute rest break"
  }'
```
##### Response (`200 OK`)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "commandId": "CMD-MUYS8QU1",
    "recognizedIntent": "LOG_HOS_EVENT",
    "confidenceScore": 0.98,
    "extractedParameters": {
      "targetStatus": "OFF_DUTY",
      "durationMinutes": 30
    },
    "coPilotVoiceReply": "Affirmative, Jeremiah. Logging duty status as OFF DUTY. Your 30-minute FMCSA rest break clock is now active. Rest well.",
    "dispatchedActionTaken": true
  }
}
```

#### 5. Errors & Edge Cases
| Status Code | Error Code | Description / Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `400 Bad Request` | `MISSING_TRANSCRIPT` | `transcript` string field was omitted. |

### `POST` `/api/v1/copilot/vision`
Implemented in [`coPilotService.processMultimodalVision`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/first-project/blob/main/src/services/copilot.ts#L105-L148).

#### 1. Purpose
Analyzes in-cab camera imagery, Bill of Lading (BOL) shipping papers, or tire tread wear using Gemini multimodal vision models with cryptographic SHA-256 seal generation.

#### 2. Parameters & Request Body
* **Request Body** (`application/json`):
  * `vehicleId` (`string`, required) – Commercial tractor ID.
  * `driverId` (`string`, required) – Driver ID.
  * `inspectionContext` (`string`, required) – `BOL_SCAN` | `CARGO_DAMAGE_INSPECTION` | `PRE_TRIP_TIRE_SURVEY`.
  * `imageBase64` (`string`, required) – Base64 encoded image string.
  * `promptNotes` (`string`, optional) – Driver notes.

#### 3. Response Shape & Status Codes
* **Status**: `200 OK`
* **Schema**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "inspectionId": "string",
    "detectedIssues": [],
    "legibilityConfidence": 0.992,
    "passedInspection": true,
    "multimodalSummary": "string",
    "sha256Hash": "string (64-char hex)"
  }
}
```

#### 4. Example Request & Response
##### Request
```bash
curl -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/v1/copilot/vision" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "vehicleId": "TRK-900",
    "driverId": "DRV-7701",
    "inspectionContext": "BOL_SCAN",
    "imageBase64": "data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQEASABIAAD..."
  }'
```

```json
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "inspectionId": "VIS-MUYS9K2L",

    "sha256Hash": "b3f07a21dd9382e70bcde9a203f7e50c4bb2e6840733c945be7293a1cf5529ab"
  }
}
```

#### 5. Errors & Edge Cases
| Status Code | Error Code | Description / Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
